```{r setup, echo=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.align = "center", fig.width = 11, fig.height = 5, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())
ggplot2::theme_set(ggplot2::theme_bw() + ggplot2::theme(panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(source(here::here("R/load_all.R")))
```

Every tracker loses WIS after the peak. Both sections calibrate the clean replay, cold: E02 switches the offset off from a date (and tries a per-level and a seasonal learning rate); E17 shrinks the offset from 1 March instead. Each section is a self-contained experiment with its own runs;
the ids match `notes/calibration-ledger.md`.

```{r e02, results="asis"}
cal_section("_e02_eta_variants.Rmd", list(workers = params$workers))
```

```{r e17, results="asis"}
cal_section("_e17_late_decay.Rmd", list(workers = params$workers))
```
